title: AC1024 dynamic-object candidates and peer silent-loss reconciliation
scope: Refresh the dynamic-block writer and reader evidence for the local AC1024 BLOCKLOOKUPACTION residual.
Compare candidate PERSUBENTMGR parser evidence with the unresolved LibreDWG layout report and source-version provenance.
Cross-check a current AC1032 INSERT silent-loss report and refine existing per-source disposition gates.
Update implementation readiness without adding external fixtures, peer dependencies, full-suite frequency, or support claims.

sources.revision: PR merged 2026-07-31 as 35a1aad; five checks passed
sources.observed: The merged PR records DWG/DXF reader and writer work for evaluation graphs, block representation data, lookup actions/parameters, stretch actions, and multiple dynamic-block parameter/grip types. Its description says modified instances still lose parameter relationships; it also adds peer test files and cases.
sources.evidenceCeiling: A merged peer PR and its source tests do not establish current native dynamic-block semantics or libdxfrw behavior. Its fixtures are not copied.

sources.revision: Mutable master manual, objects.in, and NEWS reviewed 2026-10-20
sources.observed: The manual publishes a typed field and DXF-code inventory for BLOCKLOOKUPACTION. Current LibreDWG metadata classifies BLOCKLOOKUPACTION and BLOCKLOOKUPPARAMETER as UNSTABLE; the prior same-sample trace had read overflow and unknown body bits.
sources.evidenceCeiling: The field inventory is not authoritative DWG byte order, and unstable status plus one peer trace is not a general parser result. ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative.

sources.revision: Issue remains open at review time; mutable issue/NEWS reviewed 2026-10-20
sources.observed: The reported candidate field order produces an implausibly large subentity count. The issue author clarified that an earlier merged change concerned ASSOCPERSSUBENTMANAGER, a distinct class, so PERSUBENTMGR remains unresolved/debugging evidence.
sources.evidenceCeiling: The issue does not establish a valid general grammar or libdxfrw defect.

sources.project: ACadRust v0.6.5 provenance and candidate PERSUBENTMGR source
sources.revision: Release tag v0.6.5 at commit 289a616, released 2026-10-18; source view checked 2026-10-20
sources.observed: The release page and main Cargo.toml identify v0.6.5 / 289a616. The visible docs.rs latest source page identifies itself as 0.5.5 and contains a candidate PERSUBENTMGR sequence with step and subentity arrays; the registry version list includes 0.6.5 dated 2026-10-18. The repository main README/docs snapshot also still advertises 0.5.5.
sources.evidenceCeiling: The displayed parser source is not shown to be the 0.6.5 tag implementation. Require a matching source/archive checksum before treating it as version-pinned evidence; its candidate sequence is not a format rule or semantic result.

sources.revision: Open peer issue reviewed 2026-10-20; customer files unavailable
sources.observed: The reporter describes INSERT counts falling from 9 to 3 and 14 to 13 after AC1032 DWG read followed by DXF or DWG output and peer readback; the report suspects read-side loss because both writers share the result.
sources.evidenceCeiling: This is a peer report without shareable inputs or independent reproduction; it does not indicate a libdxfrw failure.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-06: keep PERSUBENTMGR unsupported/debugging until authoritative/versioned layout and boundary evidence exist
PAR-07/PAR-133: use peer source as a candidate field inventory for BLOCKLOOKUPACTION while requiring ODA and producer-trace reconciliation
PAR-07/7G and PAR-14: measure INSERT identity/disposition per block/layout through read, write, and strict reopen rather than aggregate counts
assessment.planImpact: Refresh dynamic-block evidence, keep PERSUBENTMGR type 515 non-typed until source-version and normative/producer evidence align, and strengthen source-INSERT accounting using existing plan owners.

method.kind: Primary-source web research; plan and receipt update only
method.limitations: Peer issues and master documentation can change. ACadRust's docs.rs latest source is not aligned with the inspected 0.6.5 release identity; no field sequence from that page is used as 0.6.5 evidence. ODA v5.4.1 and a versioned producer trace remain necessary for DWG layout decisions.
